scientific_integrity: The finite-N sign classification is analytically proved, including an all-N Gaussian interpolation bound. The included diagnostic quadrature is not substituted for the infinite-population proof.
scientific_limitations: Does not address non-Poisson ages, individual resets, confinement, interacting drifts or time-dependent edge covariances. Gaussian common-age representation is prior work. No independent publication-priority verification.
scientific_scope: Stationary one-dimensional unconfined independent Brownian particles with common Poisson resets; N integer at least 2; both D and r strictly positive.
title: The four-particle sign reversal of extreme-edge covariance under synchronous Brownian resetting
